name: JOIN
description: To come together as one; to bring two or more things into connection

name: UNION
description: The state of being joined as one; a bond that holds separate parts together in common purpose

name: STREAM
description: A small body of water that flows across the land; a steady thin path of moving water

name: PREPARE
description: To make ready for what is to come; to set things in order before a task or event begins

name: HEIGHT
description: How far something rises from its base; the measure of what stands above the ground

name: TALL
description: Rising high above the ground; having great height from base to top

name: ROYAL
description: Of or belonging to a king or ruling line; having the nature of one born to the throne

name: MONARCH
description: One who rules alone over a land; a king or queen who holds the crown by birth

name: GAP
description: An empty space between two things; an opening where something is missing or apart

name: ARGUMENT
description: A clash of ideas spoken with force; a dispute where each side holds to its own view

name: YOUNG
description: Early in life; not yet old; full of the energy and growth that comes at the start of being

name: MALE
description: Of the kind that gives seed; the form of life that is the father, not the mother

name: BEAT
description: To strike again and again with a steady rhythm; the pulse that marks time in sound or body

name: INTERPRET
description: To find the meaning within; to turn what is seen or heard into understanding through thought

name: LAYER
description: A single flat spread of matter laid upon another; one of many sheets that build a whole

name: ELEMENT
description: One of the basic parts from which all things are made; a kind of matter that cannot be broken further

name: FLY
description: To move through the air with wings or by the force of lifting; to rise and travel above the ground

name: COOK
description: To make food ready by heat; to change what is raw into something that can be taken in

name: EAT
description: To take food into the body through the mouth; to consume what gives the body strength

name: WEAVE
description: To pass threads over and under each other to make cloth; to build a whole from many strands
